description.zh: 1932 年 1 月 28 日夜，日军海军陆战队自虹口租界向闸北进攻，第十九路军奋起抵抗，一·二八淞沪抗战爆发。原线起点画在长江口外，与事变地点无关；现改为虹口至闸北的进攻段。
description.en: On the night of 28 January 1932 Japanese marines advanced from the Hongkou concession into Zhabei, and the 19th Route Army resisted, beginning the January 28 defence of Shanghai. The former line began outside the Yangtze estuary, unrelated to the incident; it is now the Hongkou–Zhabei attack.

name.zh: 灵丘—平型关（日军第 5 师团进攻）

description.zh: 1937 年 9 月 20 日日军第 5 师团占领灵丘（今灵丘县，114.24°E 39.44°N），随即沿灵丘—平型关大道南下；9 月 25 日八路军第 115 师在乔沟伏击其辎重部队。原线起点误置于灵丘以西约 60 公里，已改正为灵丘县城。
description.en: On 20 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division took Lingqiu (114.24°E 39.44°N) and moved south along the Lingqiu–Pingxingguan road; on 25 September the 115th Division ambushed its supply column at Qiaogou. The former start lay about 60 km west of Lingqiu and has been corrected to the county town.

name.zh: 大同—忻口—太原（日军第 5 师团等）

description.zh: 1937 年 9 月 13 日日军占大同，随后沿同蒲路南下；10 月 13 日猛攻忻口，中国军队凭险坚守二十余日，11 月 2 日南撤，11 月 8 日太原失守。原线起点作大同但无前置，现补占大同并改为完整南下序列。
description.en: On 13 September 1937 the Japanese took Datong and moved south along the Tongpu railway; on 13 October they attacked Xinkou, where the Chinese army held for over twenty days before withdrawing on 2 November, Taiyuan falling on 8 November. The former line began at Datong without a precedent; the capture of Datong is now included.

description.zh: 1938 年 1 月 10 日日军在青岛登陆，随后沿胶济路西进；3 月起第 5 师团自潍县南下进攻临沂，与守军激战至 4 月。原线起点青岛无前置，现补登陆一段。
description.en: On 10 January 1938 the Japanese landed at Qingdao and moved west along the Jiaoji railway; from March the 5th Division advanced south from Weixian against Linyi, fighting until April. The former line began at Qingdao without a precedent; the landing is now included.

name.zh: 兰封会战（菏泽—兰封—开封）

description.zh: 1938 年 5 月 14 日日军第 14 师团占菏泽后南下，24 日陷兰封；中国军队 12 个师围攻未果，日军增援抵达，6 月 6 日占开封。原线作商丘—开封，与土肥原师团自菏泽南下的实际路线不符；现改为菏泽—兰封—开封。
description.en: After taking Heze on 14 May 1938 the Japanese 14th Division moved south and took Lanfeng on the 24th; twelve Chinese divisions failed to destroy it, Japanese reinforcements arrived and Kaifeng fell on 6 June. The former line ran Shangqiu–Kaifeng, which does not match Dohihara’s advance from Heze; it is now Heze–Lanfeng–Kaifeng.

description.zh: 1938 年 8 月 27 日日军第 2 军自六安西进，沿大别山北麓攻商城、潢川，9 月 16 日占商城。原线终点作立煌（今金寨），但日军此路并未进攻立煌；现改为六安—商城。
description.en: On 27 August 1938 the Japanese 2nd Army moved west from Lu’an along the northern Dabie foothills against Shangcheng and Huangchuan, taking Shangcheng on 16 September. The former line ended at Lihuang (Jinzhai), which this column did not attack; it is now Lu’an–Shangcheng.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 21 日日军第 21 军自大亚湾登陆后经增城进抵广州，当日入城，广州失守。原线起点在城东 10 公里外，现改为自城郊入城的一段。
description.en: On 21 October 1938 the Japanese 21st Army, having landed at Daya Bay, reached Guangzhou via Zengcheng and entered the city that day, which then fell. The former line began some 10 km east of the city; it is now the entry from the outskirts.

description.zh: 1941 年 10 月 2 日日军第 35 师团自开封、中牟一带进攻郑州，4 日占郑州，中国军队反攻，11 月初日军撤回。原线起点作中牟，无前置；现自开封出发，接「日军自开封进攻郑州」事件。
description.en: On 2 October 1941 the Japanese 35th Division attacked Zhengzhou from the Kaifeng–Zhongmu area, taking it on the 4th; the Chinese counter-attacked and the Japanese withdrew in early November. The former line began at Zhongmu without a precedent; it now starts at Kaifeng, anchored by the departure event.

description.zh: 1943 年 11 月 2 日日军第 11 军自公安、石首一带南下，12 月 3 日攻入常德；中国军队反攻，12 月下旬日军退回。原线起点在公安以西，无前置；现自公安出发，接「日军自公安进攻常德」事件。
description.en: On 2 November 1943 the Japanese 11th Army moved south from the Gong’an–Shishuo area and entered Changde on 3 December; the Chinese counter-attacked and the Japanese withdrew in late December. The former line began west of Gong’an without a precedent; it now starts at Gong’an, anchored by the departure event.

description.zh: 九一八事变后日军自沈阳西进，1932 年 1 月 3 日占领锦州。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident Japanese forces advanced west from Shenyang and took Jinzhou on 3 January 1932. Illustrative simplified route, pending historical review.

description.zh: 1933 年 1 月 1 日日军自锦州方向进攻山海关，东北军何柱国部抵抗，3 日榆关失守。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 1 January 1933 Japanese forces from the Jinzhou direction attacked Shanhaiguan; He Zhuguo’s Northeast Army troops resisted until the pass fell on 3 January. Illustrative simplified route.

name.zh: 锦州—朝阳—承德（热河作战）

description.zh: 1933 年 2 月 21 日日军分路进攻热河，3 月 4 日占领承德。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: On 21 February 1933 Japanese forces attacked Rehe along several axes and occupied Chengde on 4 March. Illustrative simplified route, pending historical review.

description.zh: 热河失守后日军南下进攻古北口，与中国守军在长城一线激战。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Rehe Japanese forces moved south against Gubeikou and fought Chinese defenders along the Great Wall. Illustrative simplified route.

name.zh: 山海关—喜峰口（长城东段）

description.zh: 日军沿长城东段进攻喜峰口、冷口等关口，第二十九军等部在此抵抗。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: Japanese forces attacked Xifengkou, Lengkou, and other passes along the eastern Great Wall, where the 29th Army and others resisted. Illustrative simplified route, pending historical review.

name.zh: 商都—红格尔图—百灵庙（绥远作战）

description.zh: 日本关东军策动伪蒙军自商都西进，进攻红格尔图与百灵庙，被傅作义部击退。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: The Kwantung Army directed Mengjiang forces west from Shangdu against Honggeertu and Bailingmiao, where Fu Zuoyi’s troops repelled them. Illustrative simplified route, pending historical review.

name.zh: 天尾港—海口（日军登陆海南岛）

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日，日军台湾混成旅团在琼山天尾港登陆，分左右两翼攻占府城、海口；守军保安部队抵抗后撤往定安山区。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: On 10 February 1939 the Japanese Taiwan Mixed Brigade landed at Tianwei Port in Qiongshan and took Fucheng and Haikou in two wings; the security troops withdrew to the Ding’an mountains after resisting. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 三亚湾—榆林（日军登陆三亚）

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 14 日拂晓，日本海军陆战队在三亚湾登陆，当日占领三亚、榆林，深夜占领崖城。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: At dawn on 14 February 1939 Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Sanya Bay, took Sanya and Yulin that day and Yacheng late that night. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

description.zh: 日军占领石碌后修建石碌—八所港铁路和八所港码头，将铁矿砂运往日本；示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: After occupying Shilu, Japan built the Shilu–Basuo railway and Basuo port to ship iron ore to Japan; schematic simplified route, pending historical review.

name.zh: 长春—吉林（九一八后东进）

description.zh: 1931 年 9 月 19 日至 21 日，日军自长春沿吉长铁路东进，占领吉林省城吉林。示意简化路线。
description.en: From 19 to 21 September 1931 Japanese forces advanced east from Changchun along the Jilin–Changchun railway and occupied Jilin City. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 长春—洮南—齐齐哈尔（江桥作战）

description.zh: 1931 年 11 月，日军第 2 师团等部沿洮昂铁路北犯，在嫩江江桥遭马占山部抵抗，11 月 19 日占领齐齐哈尔。示意简化路线。
description.en: In November 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division and other units advanced north along the Tao’ang railway, met Ma Zhanshan’s resistance at the Nen River bridge, and occupied Qiqihar on 19 November. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 金山卫—嘉兴—杭州（第10军登陆）

description.zh: 1937 年 11 月 5 日，日军第 10 军在金山卫登陆，经嘉兴西进，12 月 24 日占领杭州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 5 November 1937 the Japanese 10th Army landed at Jinshanwei, advanced west through Jiaxing and occupied Hangzhou on 24 December. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1937 年 12 月 27 日济南沦陷后，日军沿胶济铁路东进，1938 年 1 月 10 日占领青岛。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Jinan on 27 December 1937, Japanese forces advanced east along the Jiaoji railway and occupied Qingdao on 10 January 1938. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 5 月 10 日，日军在厦门五通登陆，经莲坂、市区推进，5 月 13 日控制厦门全岛。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 10 May 1938 Japanese forces landed at Wutong on Xiamen Island, advanced through Lianban and the city, and controlled the whole island by 13 May. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 广州—虎门—深圳（切断粤港交通）

description.zh: 1939 年 8 月 13 日，日军第 18 师团自虎门出发，在宝安登陆，8 月 15 日占领南头、深圳，切断粤港陆路交通。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 13 August 1939 the Japanese 18th Division moved from Humen, landed in Bao’an, and occupied Nantou and Shenzhen on 15 August, cutting the Guangdong–Hong Kong land route. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 21 日凌晨，日军在汕头港外妈屿岛登陆，22 日凌晨攻入汕头市区。示意简化路线。
description.en: Before dawn on 21 June 1939 Japanese forces landed on Mayu Island outside Shantou harbour and entered central Shantou in the early hours of 22 June. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 25 日，日军自汕头北上进攻潮州，27 日占领潮州城。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 25 June 1939 Japanese forces advanced north from Shantou toward Chaozhou and occupied the city on 27 June. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 南宁—镇南关—河内（进驻法属印度支那北部）

description.zh: 1940 年 9 月 22 日，日军自镇南关进入法属印度支那北部，经谅山进驻河内，切断滇越铁路。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 22 September 1940 Japanese forces entered northern French Indochina through Zhennanguan, advanced via Lang Son and occupied Hanoi, cutting the Yunnan–Vietnam railway. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1941 年 4 月 16 日至 17 日，日军第 13 军自杭州附近南渡钱塘江，占领绍兴，宁绍战役开始。示意简化路线。
description.en: From 16 to 17 April 1941 the Japanese 13th Army crossed the Qiantang River south of Hangzhou and occupied Shaoxing, opening the Ningbo–Shaoxing campaign. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 镇海—宁波（宁绍战役登陆）

description.zh: 1941 年 4 月 19 日，日军在镇海登陆，沿甬江西进，4 月 20 日占领宁波。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 19 April 1941 Japanese forces landed at Zhenhai and advanced west along the Yong River, occupying Ningbo on 20 April. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 瑞安—温州（温州第一次沦陷）

description.zh: 1941 年 4 月 18 日，日军在瑞安飞云江口登陆，占领瑞安，19 日北犯温州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 18 April 1941 Japanese forces landed at the Feiyun River mouth, occupied Rui’an and advanced north to Wenzhou on 19 April. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 闽江口—福州（第一次福州战役）
name.en: Min River estuary–Fuzhou (first battle for Fuzhou)

description.zh: 1941 年 4 月 19 日，日军在闽江口两侧登陆，经连江、长乐向福州推进，21 日占领福州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 19 April 1941 Japanese forces landed on both sides of the Min River estuary, advanced on Fuzhou via Lianjiang and Changle, and occupied the city on 21 April. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 畹町—龙陵—惠通桥（日军侵入滇西）
name.en: Wanding–Longling–Huitong Bridge (Japanese invasion of western Yunnan)

description.zh: 1942 年 5 月 3 日，日军自缅甸占领畹町，沿滇缅公路北犯，4 日占龙陵，5 日进抵惠通桥，被阻于怒江。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 3 May 1942 Japanese forces occupied Wanding from Burma, advanced north along the Burma Road, took Longling on 4 May and reached the Huitong Bridge on 5 May, where they were halted at the Salween. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 闽江口—福州（第二次福州战役）
name.en: Min River estuary–Fuzhou (second battle for Fuzhou)

description.zh: 1944 年 9 月 27 日，日军在闽江口登陆，经连江、马尾向福州推进，10 月 4 日占领福州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 27 September 1944 Japanese forces landed at the Min River estuary, advanced on Fuzhou via Lianjiang and Mawei, and occupied the city on 4 October. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 柳州—河池—独山（黔南事变）

description.zh: 1944 年 11 月 11 日柳州沦陷后，日军沿黔桂铁路北犯，经河池、南丹，12 月 2 日攻占贵州独山。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Liuzhou on 11 November 1944, Japanese forces advanced north along the Guizhou–Guangxi railway through Hechi and Nandan and captured Dushan, Guizhou, on 2 December. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 通明—海康—遂溪—广州湾（雷州半岛作战）

description.zh: 1943 年 2 月 16 日，日军独立混成第 23 旅团在雷州半岛东海岸通明、下岚登陆，占领海康、遂溪，21 日占领广州湾西营。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 16 February 1943 the Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade landed at Tongming and Xialan on the east coast of the Leizhou Peninsula, occupied Haikang and Suixi, and took Xiyang in Guangzhouwan on 21 February. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 韶关—南雄—大余—赣州（湘粤赣边区作战）

description.zh: 1945 年 1 月 28 日韶关沦陷后，日军沿粤汉铁路和赣粤公路北犯，经始兴、南雄、大余，2 月 5 日进占赣州。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Shaoguan on 28 January 1945, Japanese forces advanced north along the Canton–Hankou railway and the Jiangxi–Guangdong road through Shixing, Nanxiong and Dayu, entering Ganzhou on 5 February. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 遂川—赣州（遂川机场作战）

description.zh: 1945 年 1 月 31 日，日军第 27 师团攻占遂川机场，随后沿公路南下，2 月 5 日进占赣州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 31 January 1945 the Japanese 27th Division captured the Suichuan airfield and advanced south along the road, entering Ganzhou on 5 February. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 金华—丽水—青田—温州（温州第二次沦陷）

description.zh: 1942 年 7 月，日军小薗江混成旅团自金华沿丽水、青田南犯，7 月 11 日占领温州。示意简化路线。
description.en: In July 1942 the Japanese Kogiso Mixed Brigade advanced south from Jinhua via Lishui and Qingtian, occupying Wenzhou on 11 July. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 金华—丽水—青田—温州（温州第三次沦陷）

description.zh: 1944 年 8 月至 9 月，日军第 13 军甲支队自金华经丽水、青田南犯，9 月 9 日占领温州并长期盘踞。示意简化路线。
description.en: From August to September 1944 the Japanese 13th Army’s Kō Detachment advanced south from Jinhua via Lishui and Qingtian, occupying Wenzhou on 9 September and remaining for a prolonged period. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 南口—张家口—大同（平绥线）

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团沿平绥线西进，8 月 27 日占张家口，9 月 13 日占大同。示意简化路线。
description.en: In August 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Expeditionary Force advanced west along the Peiping–Suiyuan railway, taking Zhangjiakou on 27 August and Datong on 13 September. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 北平—保定—石家庄（平汉线）

description.zh: 1937 年 7 月北平沦陷后，日军第 1 军沿平汉线南下，9 月 24 日占保定，10 月 10 日占石家庄。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Beiping in July 1937, the Japanese 1st Army advanced south along the Peiping–Hankou railway, taking Baoding on 24 September and Shijiazhuang on 10 October. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 石家庄—娘子关—太原（正太线）

description.zh: 1937 年 10 月，日军沿正太线西进，10 月 26 日占娘子关，11 月 8 日占太原。示意简化路线。
description.en: In October 1937 Japanese forces advanced west along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway, taking Niangziguan on 26 October and Taiyuan on 8 November. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 大同—归绥—包头（平绥线西段）

description.zh: 1937 年 9 月大同沦陷后，日军沿平绥线西进，10 月 14 日占归绥，10 月 17 日占包头。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Datong in September 1937, Japanese forces advanced west along the Peiping–Suiyuan railway, taking Guisui on 14 October and Baotou on 17 October. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 7 月田独铁矿开采后，矿石经约 10 公里轻便铁路运至榆林港矿石码头装船。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the Tiandu mine opened in July 1939, ore was carried by a roughly 10-km light railway to the ore terminal at Yulin port for shipment. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 榆林—北黎（榆林—北黎铁路）

description.zh: 日军修建榆林—北黎铁路，全长约 187.9 公里，1943 年 3 月基本完工并在北黎与石八线接轨，连接榆林、三亚、八所等港口。示意简化路线。
description.en: Japan built the roughly 187.9-km Yulin–Beili railway, basically completed in March 1943 and joined to the Shilu–Basuo line at Beili, linking Yulin, Sanya, Basuo and other ports. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 老城—金江（澄迈湾登陆后西进）
name.en: Laocheng–Jinjiang (advance after the Chengmai Bay landing)

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日至 12 日，日军另部在澄迈湾东北角、老城附近登陆，随后向内地推进，4 月 14 日占澄迈县城金江。示意简化路线。
description.en: From 10 to 12 February 1939 another Japanese force landed at the northeast corner of Chengmai Bay near Laocheng and advanced inland, occupying Jinjiang, seat of Chengmai county, on 14 April. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 白马井—新英—新州（儋县登陆）

description.zh: 1939 年 4 月 16 日，日军川崎部队与海军陆战队在白马井登陆，4 月 17 日占新英港，4 月 18 日占儋县县城新州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 16 April 1939 the Japanese Kawasaki force and naval landing troops came ashore at Baimajing, took Xinying port on 17 April and Xinzhou, seat of Dan county, on 18 April. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 头灶港—崖城（崖州湾登陆）

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 14 日，日军从头灶港、大旦港、马岭干溪登陆，三路进攻崖城，2 月 15 日占领崖县县城。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 14 February 1939 Japanese forces landed at Touzao, Dadan and the dry creek west of Maling and attacked Yacheng by three routes, occupying the county seat on 15 February. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日海口、府城失守后，日军自海口东进，2 月 20 日攻占定安县城。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Haikou and Fucheng on 10 February 1939, Japanese forces advanced east from Haikou and captured Ding’an county town on 20 February. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 10 日海口失守后，日军自海口东进，2 月 22 日占文昌县城文城，2 月 23 日进入清澜港。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Haikou on 10 February 1939, Japanese forces advanced east, occupied Wencheng on 22 February and entered Qinglan port on 23 February. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 三亚—藤桥—陵水（东南沿海推进）

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 14 日日军登陆三亚后，沿海南东南沿海经藤桥向陵水推进，4 月 28 日占陵水县城。示意简化路线。
description.en: After landing at Sanya on 14 February 1939, Japanese forces advanced along the southeast coast through Tengqiao toward Lingshui and occupied the county town on 28 April. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 2 月 22 日文昌失守后，日军自文昌、定安方向向琼东推进，4 月 15 日占嘉积。具体出发地待页码级核对；示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Wenchang on 22 February 1939, Japanese forces advanced from the Wenchang–Ding’an direction into Qiongdong and occupied Jiaji on 15 April. The exact departure point awaits page-level verification; schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 4 月 14 日澄迈金江失守后，日军自澄迈方向进攻临高，4 月 18 日占临高县城。另有 9 月 25 日新盈港登陆说，出发地待页码级核对；示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Jinjiang on 14 April 1939, Japanese forces advanced from the Chengmai direction against Lingao and occupied the county town on 18 April. Another account has a landing at Xinying on 25 September; the departure point awaits page-level verification; schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 嘉积—万宁（琼东沿海推进）

description.zh: 1939 年 4 月 15 日嘉积失守后，日军沿海南东海岸南下，8 月 13 日占万宁县城。示意简化路线。
description.en: After the fall of Jiaji on 15 April 1939, Japanese forces advanced south along the east coast and occupied Wanning county town on 13 August. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，驻陵水日军出占保亭县城。示意简化路线；另有 1940-07-16 说。
description.en: On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces from Lingshui occupied Baoting county town. Schematic simplified route; another account gives 16 July 1940.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，驻崖县日军出占乐东县城（抱由）。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces from Ya county occupied Ledong county town (Baoyou). Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 八所—石碌（进攻石碌铁矿）
name.en: Basuo–Shilu (advance on the Shilu iron mine)

description.zh: 1939 年 7 月 18 日日军占八所、北黎，以此为基地向内地推进，1940 年 3 月 15 日占石碌。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 18 July 1939 Japanese forces occupied Basuo and Beili and used them as bases for advancing inland, occupying Shilu on 15 March 1940. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 八所—墩头—新街（昌江沿海占领）

description.zh: 1939 年 7 月 18 日，日军自八所、墩头登陆/推进，占领新街、墩头、八所，并在北黎设司令部。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 18 July 1939 Japanese forces landed or advanced from Basuo and Duntou and occupied Xinjie, Duntou and Basuo, establishing headquarters at Beili. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 12 日第 104 师团在平海登陆，13 日占稔山、吉隆，随后配合进攻惠州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 12 October 1938 the 104th Division landed at Pinghai, took Renshan and Jilong on 13 October and then supported the attack on Huizhou. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 盐灶背—平山—惠州（及川支队）

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 12 日及川支队在盐灶背登陆，经平山方向配合进攻惠州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 12 October 1938 the Oikawa Detachment landed at Yanzaobei and advanced via Pingshan in support of the attack on Huizhou. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 12 日第 18 师团在澳头、霞涌登陆，13 日占淡水，15 日占惠州。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 12 October 1938 the 18th Division landed at Aotou and Xiachong, took Danshui on 13 October and Huizhou on 15 October. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 15 日惠州失守后，日军经博罗、增城向广州推进，21 日占广州。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Huizhou fell on 15 October 1938, Japanese forces advanced through Boluo and Zengcheng toward Guangzhou, occupying the city on 21 October. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 21 日广州失守后，第 104 师团向北推进，23 日占从化。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Guangzhou fell on 21 October 1938, the 104th Division advanced north and occupied Conghua on 23 October. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 23 日，日军第 5 师团与海军攻占虎门要塞，控制珠江口。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 23 October 1938 the Japanese 5th Division and navy captured the Humen forts and controlled the Pearl River estuary. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 23 日虎门失守后，日军第 5 师团与海军沿珠江口西进，25 日占三水，26 日占佛山。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Humen fell on 23 October 1938, the Japanese 5th Division and navy advanced west along the Pearl River estuary, taking Sanshui on 25 October and Foshan on 26 October. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军向珠江三角洲南部推进，26 日前后占顺德各属。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, Japanese forces advanced into the southern Pearl River Delta and occupied Shunde’s towns around 26 October. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军占领番禺，控制广州南部与珠江航道。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, Japanese forces occupied Panyu and controlled southern Guangzhou and the Pearl River channels. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 3 月 28 日日军自广州方向进攻新会，30 日占江门，4 月 2 日占会城。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 28 March 1939 Japanese forces advanced from the Guangzhou direction against Xinhui, took Jiangmen on 30 March and Huicheng on 2 April. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 5 日日军藤井兵团从顺德攻入中山大小黄圃，7 日占石岐。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 5 March 1940 the Japanese Fujii Brigade entered Dahuangpu and Xiaohuangpu in Zhongshan from Shunde and occupied Shiqi on 7 March. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1940 年 3 月 6 日日军海路登陆唐家、香洲，攻陷前山、坦洲、翠亨，配合主力包围石岐。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 6 March 1940 Japanese forces landed by sea at Tangjia and Xiangzhou, took Qianshan, Tanzhou and Cuiheng, and cooperated in the encirclement of Shiqi. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1939 年 6 月 27 日潮州失守后，日军沿韩江于 29 日进占澄海。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Chaozhou fell on 27 June 1939, Japanese forces advanced along the Han River and occupied Chenghai on 29 June. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 6 月 21 日日军在钱澳、长尾山登陆，23 日控制南澳全岛。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 21 June 1938 Japanese forces landed at Qian’ao and Changweishan and controlled all of Nan’ao by 23 June. Schematic simplified route.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军向广九铁路沿线推进，11 月 26 日第一次占领宝安南头、深圳镇。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, Japanese forces advanced along the Guangzhou–Kowloon railway and first occupied Nantou and Shenzhen town on 26 November. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 广州—花县—银盏坳—源潭—英德（第104师团）

description.zh: 1939 年 11 月 27 日起，日军第 104 师团由花县新街沿粤汉铁路北犯，经银盏坳、源潭，12 月 30 日占英德。示意简化路线。
description.en: From 27 November 1939 the Japanese 104th Division advanced north from Xinjie in Hua county along the Canton–Hankou railway through Yinzhan’ao and Yuantan, occupying Yingde on 30 December. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 增城—小楼—正果—永汉—左潭—梅坑—新丰（第18师团）

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 15 日，日军第 18 师团由增城北上，经小楼、正果、永汉、左潭、梅坑，28 日占新丰。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 15 December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division advanced north from Zengcheng through Xiaolou, Zhengguo, Yonghan, Zuotan and Meikeng, occupying Xinfeng on 28 December. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 从化—鸡笼冈—良口—吕田—翁源—新江（近卫混成旅团）

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月 20 日，日军近卫混成旅团占从化，经鸡笼冈、良口、吕田，30 日占翁源，31 日占新江。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 20 December 1939 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Conghua and advanced through Jilonggang, Liangkou and Lü tian, taking Wengyuan on 30 December and Xinjiang on 31 December. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 广州—街口—鸡笼冈—良口（第二次粤北）

description.zh: 1940 年 5 月 13 日，日军第 38 师团沿广从公路北犯，17 日占街口，18 日占鸡笼冈，20 日占良口。示意简化路线。
description.en: On 13 May 1940 the Japanese 38th Division advanced north along the Guangzhou–Conghua road, taking Jiekou on 17 May, Jilonggang on 18 May and Liangkou on 20 May. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 良口—石榴花顶（第二次粤北）

description.zh: 1940 年 5 月 20 日良口失守后，日军于 22 日进攻石榴花顶，中国第 152 师顽强阻击。示意简化路线。
description.en: After Liangkou fell on 20 May 1940, Japanese forces attacked Shiliuhuading on 22 May and the Chinese 152nd Division fought a stubborn defense. Schematic simplified route.

name.zh: 新丰—梅坑—永汉—增城（1940-01 撤退）

description.zh: 1940 年 1 月 1 日，日军第 18 师团由新丰、梅坑、永汉向南退却，逐步退回增城。示意简化路线，按撤退样式绘制。
description.en: On 1 January 1940 the Japanese 18th Division withdrew south from Xinfeng, Meikeng and Yonghan toward Zengcheng. Schematic simplified route drawn in the retreat style.

name.zh: 新江—翁源—良口—从化—广州（1940-01 撤退）

description.zh: 1940 年 1 月 1 日，日军近卫混成旅团由新江、翁源经良口、从化向南退却，退回广州。示意简化路线，按撤退样式绘制。
description.en: On 1 January 1940 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade withdrew south from Xinjiang and Wengyuan via Liangkou and Conghua toward Guangzhou. Schematic simplified route drawn in the retreat style.

name.zh: 英德—银盏坳—花县—广州（1940-01 撤退）

description.zh: 1940 年 1 月 1 日，日军第 104 师团由英德沿粤汉铁路南退，经银盏坳、花县退回广州。示意简化路线，按撤退样式绘制。
description.en: On 1 January 1940 the Japanese 104th Division withdrew south from Yingde along the Canton–Hankou railway through Yinzhan’ao and Hua county toward Guangzhou. Schematic simplified route drawn in the retreat style.

name.zh: 良口—街口—广州（1940-06 撤退）

description.zh: 1940 年 6 月 1 日，日军第 38 师团由良口、街口向南退却，退回广州；中国军队 6 月 3 日收复良口、5 日收复街口。示意简化路线，按撤退样式绘制。
description.en: On 1 June 1940 the Japanese 38th Division withdrew south from Liangkou and Jiekou toward Guangzhou; Chinese forces recovered Liangkou on 3 June and Jiekou on 5 June. Schematic simplified route drawn in the retreat style.

description.zh: 1940 年 6 月 1 日，日军第 104 师团一部由花县向南退却，退回广州；中国军队 6 月 1 日收复花县。示意简化路线，按撤退样式绘制。
description.en: On 1 June 1940 elements of the Japanese 104th Division withdrew south from Hua county toward Guangzhou; Chinese forces recovered Hua county on 1 June. Schematic simplified route drawn in the retreat style.

description.zh: 1937年11月13日，日军从白茆口、浒浦一带登陆，经支塘向常熟县城进犯，11月19日陷常熟。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 13 November 1937 Japanese forces landed at Baimaokou and Hupu, advanced via Zhitang on Changshu and took the town on 19 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月15日日军进攻昆山，随后沿京沪铁路西进，11月19日攻入苏州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Japanese forces attacked Kunshan on 15 November 1937 and advanced west along the Nanjing–Shanghai railway, entering Suzhou on 19 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月19日，日军由常熟向苏州进攻，与昆山方向一路合攻苏州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces advanced from Changshu toward Suzhou, converging with the Kunshan column. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月19日苏州失守后，日军沿京杭运河与铁路西进，11月25日侵占无锡。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Suzhou fell on 19 November 1937, Japanese forces advanced west along the Grand Canal and railway and occupied Wuxi on 25 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月25日无锡失守后，日军第16师团沿铁路西进，11月29日攻占常州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Wuxi fell on 25 November 1937, the Japanese 16th Division advanced west along the railway and took Changzhou on 29 November. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月29日常州失守后，日军沿京沪铁路西进，12月2日陷丹阳，12月8日陷镇江。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Changzhou fell on 29 November 1937, Japanese forces advanced west along the Nanjing–Shanghai railway, taking Danyang on 2 December and Zhenjiang on 8 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月28日宜兴失守后，太湖南岸一路日军经溧阳、溧水、句容向南京迂回。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Yixing fell on 28 November 1937, the Japanese column south of Taihu moved via Liyang, Lishui and Jurong to outflank Nanjing. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月29日常州失守后，日军第9师团经金坛西进，12月2日陷金坛，12月4日陷溧水。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Changzhou fell on 29 November 1937, the Japanese 9th Division advanced west via Jintan, taking Jintan on 2 December and Lishui on 4 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月25日无锡失守后，日军从无锡三面围攻江阴，12月2日攻占江阴要塞。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Wuxi fell on 25 November 1937, Japanese forces attacked Jiangyin from three directions and took the fortress on 2 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月8日镇江失守后，日军第13师团天谷支队渡江，12月14日攻占扬州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Zhenjiang fell on 8 December 1937, the Japanese 13th Division's Amaya detachment crossed the Yangtze and took Yangzhou on 14 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年3月17日，日军约5000人在姚港登陆后直入南通城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 17 March 1938 about 5,000 Japanese troops landed at Yaogang and entered Nantong. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年3月17日南通失守后，日军沿公路西进，3月19日侵占如皋。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Nantong fell on 17 March 1938, Japanese forces advanced west along the road and occupied Rugao on 19 March. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年3月21日，日军由南通沿公路进犯海门，占领茅镇、三厂、青龙港、四甲坝。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 21 March 1938 Japanese forces advanced from Nantong along the road into Haimen, occupying Maozhen, Sanchang, Qinglonggang and Sijiaba. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年3月19日如皋失守后，日军连下海安、东台，3月25日侵占东台城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Rugao fell on 19 March 1938, Japanese forces took Hai'an and Dongtai in succession, occupying Dongtai on 25 March. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年3月25日东台失守后，日军北犯，4月26日占盐城，5月7日占阜宁。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Dongtai fell on 25 March 1938, Japanese forces advanced north, taking Yancheng on 26 April and Funing on 7 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年2月28日日军占领连云港，3月4日占领墟沟、新浦、海州，连云地区全境沦陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Japanese forces occupied Lianyungang on 28 February 1939 and Xugou, Xinpu and Haizhou on 4 March, completing the occupation of the area. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年11月，日军由徐州沿宿睢公路东犯，11月22日攻陷宿迁城（通行说法）。路线为示意简化。
description.en: In November 1938 Japanese forces advanced east from Xuzhou along the Suqian–Suining road and captured Suqian on 22 November in the common account. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 日军占宿迁后沿运河向淮阴推进，1939年3月1日侵入淮阴城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After occupying Suqian, Japanese forces advanced along the Grand Canal toward Huaiyin and entered the city on 1 March 1939. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1939年10月2日，日军由扬州沿运河北犯，侵占高邮城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 2 October 1939 Japanese forces advanced north from Yangzhou along the Grand Canal and occupied Gaoyou. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1941年2月16日，日军独立混成第12旅团由扬州方向进驻泰州。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 16 February 1941 the Japanese 12th Independent Mixed Brigade entered Taizhou from the direction of Yangzhou. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年11月30日广德失守后，日军第18师团经郎溪北犯，12月6日陷宣城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Guangde fell on 30 November 1937, the Japanese 18th Division advanced north via Langxi and took Xuancheng on 6 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月6日宣城失守后，日军经湾沚西进，12月10日攻占芜湖。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Xuancheng fell on 6 December 1937, Japanese forces advanced west via Wanzhi and took Wuhu on 10 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月10日芜湖失守后，日军沿长江东岸北进，12月11日陷当涂。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Wuhu fell on 10 December 1937, Japanese forces advanced north along the east bank of the Yangtze and took Dangtu on 11 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月11日当涂失守后，日军北进，12月23日占领马鞍山矿区。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Dangtu fell on 11 December 1937, Japanese forces moved north and occupied the Ma'anshan mines on 23 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1937年12月22日全椒失守后，日军沿滁河北进，12月24日陷滁县。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Quanjiao fell on 22 December 1937, Japanese forces advanced north along the Chu River and took Chuxian on 24 December. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年1月18日明光失陷后，日军沿津浦铁路南段北犯，2月1日陷临淮关，2月2日陷蚌埠。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Mingguang fell on 18 January 1938, Japanese forces advanced north along the southern Tianjin–Pukou railway, taking Linhuaiguan on 1 February and Bengbu on 2 February. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年1月30日池河失陷后，日军西进，2月2日陷定远。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Chihe fell on 30 January 1938, Japanese forces advanced west and took Dingyuan on 2 February. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年2月2日蚌埠、凤阳同日失陷，日军由蚌埠向凤阳方向推进。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Bengbu and Fengyang fell on the same day, 2 February 1938; Japanese forces moved from Bengbu toward Fengyang. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年2月5日，日军由蚌埠强渡淮河，进占怀远。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 5 February 1938 Japanese forces crossed the Huai River from Bengbu and occupied Huaiyuan. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月，日军第13师团由蚌埠西犯，5月9日陷蒙城。路线为示意简化。
description.en: In May 1938 the Japanese 13th Division advanced west from Bengbu and took Mengcheng on 9 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月18日至19日，日军由宿县北犯，萧县、宿县先后失陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 18–19 May 1938 Japanese forces moved north from Suxian; Xiaoxian and Suxian fell in succession. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月19日萧县失陷后，日军继续向砀山推进，5月24日陷砀山。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Xiaoxian fell on 19 May 1938, Japanese forces advanced toward Dangshan and took it on 24 May. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月30日至31日，日军由蒙城西犯，涡阳、亳县相继失陷。路线为示意简化。
description.en: On 30–31 May 1938 Japanese forces advanced west from Mengcheng, taking Guoyang and Boxian in succession. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月14日合肥失陷后，日军沿合安公路南下，6月12日攻占安庆。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Hefei fell on 14 May 1938, Japanese forces advanced south along the Hefei–Anqing road and took Anqing on 12 June. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年6月19日潜山失陷后，日军沿大别山南麓西进，6月30日陷太湖，8月2日陷宿松。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Qianshan fell on 19 June 1938, Japanese forces advanced west along the southern foot of the Dabie Mountains, taking Taihu on 30 June and Susong on 2 August. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年5月14日合肥失陷后，日军第2军沿大别山北麓西进，8月28日陷六安。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Hefei fell on 14 May 1938, the Japanese 2nd Army advanced west along the northern foot of the Dabie Mountains and took Lu'an on 28 August. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年8月28日六安失陷后，日军第13师团南下，8月29日陷霍山。路线为示意简化。
description.en: After Lu'an fell on 28 August 1938, the Japanese 13th Division moved south and took Huoshan on 29 August. The route is schematic.

description.zh: 1938年10月28日东流、贵池失陷，11月26日铜陵失陷；日军沿长江南岸西进。路线为示意简化。
description.en: Dongliu and Guichi fell on 28 October 1938 and Tongling on 26 November; Japanese forces advanced west along the south bank of the Yangtze. The route is schematic.
